heading: How we look after your personal information
intro: FAP name: GB Mortgages Limited. FSP number: FSP1013399.
seo_description: How GB Mortgages collects, uses, discloses and protects your personal information under the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
GB Mortgages Limited (trading as GB Mortgages) ("we", "us", "our") complies with the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020 (the Act) when dealing with personal information. Personal information is information about an identifiable individual (a natural person). This policy sets out how we collect, use, disclose and protect your personal information.

This policy does not limit or exclude any of your rights under the Act.

Our Privacy Officer is Philippa Impey, who you can contact at hello@gbmortgages.co.nz. You can also visit www.privacy.org.nz for more information.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may change this policy by publishing a revised version on our website. The change applies from the date we publish it.

sections.title: What is personal information?
sections.body: Personal information is information about an identifiable individual. It includes (but is not limited to) name, address, contact details, date of birth, occupations, payment details, employment history and/or details, education and qualifications, financial information, testimonials and feedback, evidence of source of funds or source of wealth (in some cases) and other information.

sections.title: Third party collection of information
sections.body: Where we collect your personal information from someone other than you, we will take reasonable steps to notify you that we have collected your personal information, the purpose of the collection, the intended recipients of the information, the name and address of the agency collecting and holding the information, whether the collection is authorised or required by law and, if so, the law that authorises or requires the collection, and your right to access and request correction of that information, unless an exception applies under the Privacy Act 2020. For example, we may collect information about you from a lender, your accountant, a credit reporting agency, or a co-borrower or guarantor on the same application.

sections.title: How we use your personal information
sections.body:
We will use your personal information:

- to verify your identity
- to provide services and products to you
- to market our services and products to you, including contacting you electronically (e.g. by call, text, or email for this purpose)
- to improve the services and products that we provide to you
- to respond to communications from you, including a complaint
- to protect and/or enforce our legal rights and interests, including defending any claim
- for any other purpose authorised by you or the Act.

sections.title: Disclosing your personal information
Protecting your personal information
sections.body: We take reasonable steps to keep your personal information safe from loss, unauthorised access, use, modification or disclosure, and other misuse. Client files are held in Trail, a cloud system that encrypts data in transit and at rest. We use multi-factor authentication, encrypted devices and security software, and we do not keep client files on personal or shared devices.

sections.title: Storing your personal information
sections.body: We keep personal information only as long as we need it for the purposes it may lawfully be used for. Financial advice records are kept for at least seven years, as the law requires, and then securely destroyed. Information stored online is backed up so it can be recovered if it is lost or corrupted. Some of our service providers store information outside New Zealand (for example, Trail stores data in Australia); we use providers that protect information to a standard comparable to New Zealand's. Paper documents, if any, are held securely at our office in Kelvin Heights, Queenstown, then scanned into Trail and destroyed.

sections.title: Accessing and correcting your personal information
sections.body:
Subject to certain grounds for refusal set out in the Act, you have the right to access your readily retrievable personal information that we hold and to request a correction to your personal information. Before you exercise this right, we will need evidence to confirm that you are the individual to whom the personal information relates.

In respect of a request for correction, if we think the correction is reasonable and we are reasonably able to change the personal information, we will make the correction. If we do not make the correction, we will take reasonable steps to note the personal information that you requested the correction.

To make a request, email us at hello@gbmortgages.co.nz. Your email should include evidence of who you are and set out the details of your request (for example, the personal information or the correction you are asking for).

sections.title: Data breaches
sections.body: If a privacy breach occurs, our Privacy Officer will act promptly to contain it and assess the harm. If a breach has caused, or is likely to cause, serious harm, we will notify the Privacy Commissioner and the people affected as soon as practicable, as the Act requires. We will also tell Kiwi Adviser Network and any lender involved.

sections.title: Internet use
sections.body:
While we take reasonable steps to maintain secure internet connections, if you provide us with personal information over the internet, the provision of that information is at your own risk.

If you follow a link on our website to another site, the owner of that site will have its own privacy policy relating to your personal information. We suggest you review that site's privacy policy before you provide personal information.

We use cookies (an alphanumeric identifier that we transfer to your computer's hard drive so that we can recognise your browser) to monitor your use of the website. You may disable cookies by changing the settings on your browser, although this may mean that you cannot use all of the features of the website.

We may use information about your use of our websites and other IT systems to prevent unauthorised access or attacks on our software. We may utilise services from one or more third-party suppliers to monitor the use of our systems. These third-party suppliers will have access to monitoring and logging information as well as information processed on our websites and other IT systems.

We do not enter your personal information into artificial intelligence (AI) tools unless the tool has been approved under our Responsible Use of AI policy and protects your information to the same standard as our other systems.
